headline: NFLPA calls for 'full investigation' into medical care provided to Eagles' Hurts
take:
I can't write this one as a hockey take. The only report in the data is about the NFLPA and the Eagles' Jalen Hurts, a football story. It has no link to any NHL player or team, and the PHI numbers in the JSON belong to the Flyers, not the Eagles. If I tied them together, I'd be inventing a connection the facts don't support.

If you send a hockey story, or the right report for the NHL team and players you mean to cover, I'll turn it around in the same format.
